label: dead-symbol-no-consumer-or-definition
name: Added or touched symbol, include, parameter, branch, statement or file has no consumer (or no definition) at HEAD
description: What breaks: text that compiles to nothing or that nobody reads. A member superseded by a new field (kv_k_base after shards[], 2982429237); a parameter every caller passes empty so the callee hunks are dead (3001962017, 3002028759); a function with no caller (dump_kv_cache_from_hbm 2737943442; clear_kv_complete 3029165954 'how come I don't see this being called anywhere?'); an include or using-alias whose consumer moved to another file (2729005716, 2737844615, 2737956124, 2737956568, 2738033592, 2771713070); duplicate #include lines left by a merge (2915281512 'perhaps a merge artifact?', 2915281835); a constant nobody references (short_timeout_ns 3350291154); a member allocated in the constructor and never read (empty_v_block 2941308844); a variable declared outside the #ifdef that is its only user (2915258232); a branch unreachable under its enclosing guard (3405963004); a statement after TRON_ASSERT(false) (3120804824); a second TRACE_EVENT_END for the same span (3307450424); an edit to a header no target compiles (hwattention_dump.hpp 3866653656 'this is a dead file'); an extern declaration whose definition is nowhere in the PR (3463077403 'where's the actual implementation for this now?'). Procedure: for every name declared, included or aliased in added lines, grep h/ src/ t/ bin/ ingest/ at HEAD excluding the declaration; for every added parameter list each call site's argument; for every added include list the symbols the file uses from it; for an if inside a guarded block check whether the enclosing condition already fixes it; for every declaration left without a body find the definition; for each touched header count includers. Ask form: 'what does this #include get us?', 'left over cruft?', 'can this go away?'.
disposition_reason: No existing check searches for consumers or definitions; check 10 asks whether a hunk belongs to the feature, not whether anything uses it. Count 21 over 12 PRs.
agent_feasibility: yes: grep for consumers of every added declaration, include and parameter; includer count per header; the unreachable-branch case needs reading the enclosing condition.
